images.title: A pyramid on a 10 sided base
images.purpose: Show where the faces, edges and vertices of a pyramid on a 10 sided base come from.
images.composition: One large decagonal pyramid centred on white, base edges in one colour and slant edges in another, with three count labels to the right.
images.exact_structure: One pyramid, about 70 percent of the frame height, centred left. Its base is a regular decagon seen slightly from above, with exactly 10 base vertices and exactly 10 base edges drawn in teal #0072B2; the 4 base edges at the back are dashed and the other 6 are solid. One apex point sits directly above the centre of the base, marked with a reddish purple #CC79A7 dot and labelled 'apex'. Exactly 10 slant edges run from the apex to the 10 base vertices, drawn in amber #E69F00; exactly 3 slant edges, those to the 3 back vertices between the two outline edges, are dashed, and the other 7 are solid. Faces are white with no fill. The base is labelled '10 sided base'. To the right, stacked: '11 faces', '20 edges', '11 vertices'.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: 10 edges round the base and 10 up to the apex make 20 edges.
